app.name: severity-assistant
app.description: Configure Davis event severity rules based on event name and metadata

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Grail bucket-level read grant, required in addition to storage:events:read -- see docs/06-app-scaffolding.md

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Query dt.davis.events for history, discovery, simulation

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: Read the role registry and rules (app-wide state, shared across users)

scopes.name: state:app-states:write
scopes.comment: Write the role registry and rules

scopes.name: state:app-states:delete
scopes.comment: Delete a removed profile's stored rules

scopes.name: davis:analyzers:execute
scopes.comment: LogPatternExtractor: suggest threshold patterns from real event descriptions
